Sophie / Mike — thanks for the questions. Below is a concise commercial proposal and packaging recommendation tailored to DataOps usage profile discussed in the demo. Numbers below are list before discounts; we also include recommended discounts for committed terms.

Summary options (monthly unit prices):
- Retention (per-GB-month): 30d = $0.18, 90d = $0.12, 365d = $0.06 (365d assumes cold-tier storage + retrieval latency SLA)
- Tracing: base sampled tier $15 per 1M spans; high-fidelity tier (higher sampling + retention) $40 per 1M spans
- Advanced Dashboards: Seat model $25/seat/month; Account bundle = $2,500/month for unlimited seats & advanced connectors

Packaging recommendation (based on your infra size):
- Observability Standard (recommended): 90d retention + base tracing + 10 seats dashboards
  - Estimated monthly list: retention $5,200 + tracing $1,800 + dashboards $250 = $7,250
- Observability Enterprise: 365d retention + high-fidelity tracing + account bundle dashboards + audit export
  - Estimated monthly list: retention $12,000 + tracing $5,400 + dashboards $2,500 = $19,900

Discounting guidance (applies to add-ons only):
- 12-month commit: 20% off add-ons
- 24-month commit: 30% off add-ons + 1 month free at term start
- Volume tier (ingest > 20 TB/mo): additional 10% off retention tier pricing (stackable)

Other notes:
- Dashboards audit/export: yes — the account bundle includes full audit logs (SOC2-ready artifact) and a daily export for retention obligations. Evelyn can provide the SOC2 artifact during procurement.
- Trial: recommend offering a 2-week 90d retention trial (no charge) during procurement evaluation to validate sampling rates and dashboards.

Proposed ask: if DataOps can commit to 12 months for the Enterprise bundle, we can offer 20% off list plus the volume tier if you cross the 20 TB threshold. That should meet the ~15–20% target you mentioned.

If this looks ok, Ben — can you confirm preferred term (12 vs 24) and whether DataOps wants seat or account bundle for dashboards? I will create the SOW and an updated pricing attachment once you confirm.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
